title: Transposing Sketchpad
user: Beginning composers writing for transposing instruments who need to hear and enter the sounding pitch without repeatedly doing notation arithmetic.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with a two-staff written/sounding view, six common transposing instruments, keyboard/MIDI entry, instant playback, and a shareable eight-bar sketch.
constraints: Web MIDI is optional; audio and files stay local; synthesized sounds only; clear instrument-range warnings.
